job.title: SYMPHONY: Enabling Compute-Memory Disaggregation in LLM Serving Systems
job.selection_reason: NSDI 2026の査読論文。KV cache storageをcomputeから分離し、user interaction/workload structure由来のadvisory prefetch、priority-based KV management、GPU-serving framework協調memory管理を設計する。LLaMA/ShareGPT/Burst-GPT評価でend-to-end latency 2.4x改善、低latencyのまま4x requestを処理し、disaggregated memory重点系統に直接該当。
